reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed record identifiers and maps only exact need matches to direct capability coverage. The two truly unsupported needs remain unsupported, and the exact handoff-related capability is preserved in the coverage output.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage is direct. As a result, covered needs are ranked before actually unsupported needs, contradicting the declared role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs and making the priority table behaviorally misleading.

synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item window and derives the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority record as declared. Its observed recommendation is contaminated by the failed priority table from bnd-ec8195a15cc684b4, so the local boundary is not the source of the behavioral fault.
